description: PRE-REGISTERED paraphrase scenarios for the LIVE run only (not read by pytest; the keyword mock cannot classify them). Same correct behaviours as eval_scenarios/, different wording. Expectations were fixed before the first run from the sprint contract's behaviours and are never edited to match a result.

scenarios.behaviour: A booking worded as a favour still asks first, runs once on yes, and is verified.
turns: could you fit me in at the downtown store tomorrow around 3 in the afternoon?

scenarios.behaviour: A refund asked for as 'my money back' still waits for an operator and runs nothing.
turns: this jacket fell apart after two washes, I'd like my money back for AC-12345

scenarios.behaviour: A status question without the usual words is still a read-only lookup.
turns: any news on package AC-12345? it has been a week

scenarios.behaviour: Wanting someone to take over, without the keywords, reaches the handoff path.
turns: this is going nowhere, I want someone on your team to take over

scenarios.behaviour: An opening-hours question is answered from knowledge and runs no tool.
turns: what time do you open on saturdays?
